purpose: Additional independent-site leads from public primary articles. Source data and rights not obtained; no methane model evaluation or independent validation.

sources.source_publication: Research on coal mine longwall face gas state analysis and safety warning strategy based on multi-sensor forecasting models (Scientific Reports 2024)
sources.source_description: The paper describes a separately studied Chinese coal-mine working face at Qianyingzi (W3211), May to July 2021, with 3,407,328 reported data points and a one-minute-standardized analysis. It says data are available by request to the corresponding author. Original full-resolution 1 Hz stream, 28 physically equivalent canonical measurements, event annotations, rights and independent provenance were not obtained; data-point counts are not treated as timestamped one-second rows.

sources.source_publication: Interpretable Graph–Temporal–Spectral Fusion for Precursor-Related Anomaly Detection in Underground Mine Sensor Networks (Sensors 2026)
sources.source_description: The paper describes a separately studied Xinyuan mine 31002 working face, methane/ventilation/equipment monitoring and eight annotated precursor-related abnormal intervals. Monitoring inputs were averaged into 15-second intervals and the principal comparison used 5-minute intervals. The publication explicitly states that field data are not publicly available under mine confidentiality agreements. No original 1 Hz/28-channel canonical stream or permission was acquired; precursor anomaly detection is not the frozen 3–6-minute methane exceedance task.

sources.source_publication: Interpretable Event-Driven Multisensor Risk-Evolution Analysis for Methane Early Warning (Sensors 2026)
sources.source_description: The 2026 Sensors publication explicitly says its one-second underground-coal-mine dataset is the Mendeley Methane dataset 10.17632/yd7vw4c5mk.1, which is the 2014 Polish development/training source for the frozen MUSITU methane model. Later publication dates, model architectures, new metrics and dataset links do not make the same original sensor stream an independent mine or a prospective holdout. Original third-party source bytes and new mine rights were not obtained.
